correction_plans.root_cause: the candidate was emitted as one undifferentiated silhouette on a page narrower than the body, so it rendered cropped with no distinguishable closure or collar
correction_plans.required_change: draw separate visible component contours and size the page from the body width

correction_plans.root_cause: band boundaries sat on transition rows, blending two widths and leaving a notch between closure and collar
correction_plans.required_change: move band boundaries inside each component and extend the sleeve to meet the flare

correction_plans.root_cause: width and height were normalized independently to 1.0 and x was scaled by height, making the render 1:1 instead of 3.08:1. The profile comparison divides by body width and was structurally blind to it; the visual inspector caught it
correction_plans.required_change: scale x by ASPECT_W_OVER_H and add an assembly-aspect gate

correction_plans.root_cause: the closure contour terminates at its band top with a finite half-width, so the mirror closes it with a straight line and the dome reads as a flat trapezoid
correction_plans.required_change: carry the closure contour to zero half-width at the apex so the dome closes as a curve
correction_plans.note: identified but NOT applied — all three inspector calls are consumed and §11 stops the loop

iteration_1.reference_description: A dropper bottle for 'BBROSE Rose Damascena Night Repair Oil'. The bottle body is frosted/matte glass with a soft blush-pink tint, cylindrical with gently rounded shoulders. The closure assembly consists of: a wide rose-gold/champagne metallic collar that screws onto the bottle neck, topped by a dark plum/aubergine rubber pipette bulb that is rounded-dome shaped at the top. The bulb is large, smooth, and sits prominently above the metallic collar. The label text is printed directly on the frosted glass in dark rose/burgundy tones.
iteration_1.output_description: A flat, nearly textureless off-white/cream silhouette of a bottle upper section only. The shape shows a wide cylindrical body tapering inward in stepped/tiered increments toward a narrow neck at the top. There are three visible horizontal ledge-steps on the shoulder/neck transition area. No dropper bulb is present, no collar is visible, no color differentiation, no label, no closure details. The image is cropped and shows only roughly the top half of a bottle form.
iteration_1.top_component_observed_shape: Absent — no closure component visible; only a flat stepped/tiered neck silhouette is present

component_semantics.evidence: No bulb, no collar, no dropper assembly of any kind is rendered. The top of the render terminates in a flat stepped neck with no closure element attached.

No label or text elements
Image appears cropped, showing only upper portion with no base
Bottle proportions are much wider relative to height compared to reference tall cylindrical form

critical_blockers: Stepped shoulder geometry is structurally incorrect — reference has smooth rounded transition
Bottle appears to be different form factor entirely (wider, squatter proportions)
Render is incomplete/cropped with no base visible

iteration_3.reference_description: A frosted glass dropper bottle with a soft pinkish-mauve tone. The bottle is cylindrical with gently rounded shoulders, a short neck, and a wide body that tapers slightly at the base. The closure system consists of a rose-gold/champagne metallic collar (wide, prominent, approximately 1/4 the bottle height) that threads onto the neck, topped by a large smooth rounded rubber pipette bulb in deep plum/aubergine color. The bulb is hemispherical-to-ovoid, clearly exposed above the collar. Label reads 'BBROSE Rose Damascena Night Repair Oil'. Overall silhouette is tall and elegant, with the bulb and collar together forming roughly 30% of total height.
iteration_3.output_description: A synthetic render showing a squat, wide cylindrical bottle body in off-white/cream color with very little neck definition. The top closure area consists of a flat, stepped beige/cream disk-like collar that is disproportionately wide and flat compared to reference. Above the collar sits a very small, flat-topped trapezoidal dark plum shape — not a rounded bulb, but more like a truncated pyramid or flat pad. The body is extremely wide and short relative to the reference, giving a jar-like appearance rather than a dropper bottle. No gold/metallic collar visible; no bottle neck visible; bottle proportions are completely wrong.
iteration_3.top_component_observed_shape: Flat-topped truncated trapezoid (small dark plum pad sitting on a wide stepped cream disk)

component_semantics.evidence: The dark shape at the top is not a rounded rubber bulb — it is a flat, angular truncated trapezoid with no curvature. It does not match the exposed rubber pipette bulb of the reference. The collar is beige/cream flat disk instead of a tall rose-gold metallic band.

Collar is a flat beige disk with no metallic rose-gold finish — reference has a tall prominent gold metallic collar
Bottle body is extremely squat and wide (jar-like), reference is tall and slender cylindrical
No neck visible in render; reference has a distinct short neck between collar and shoulder
Body proportions: reference height-to-width ratio approximately 2.5:1; render appears close to 1:1

critical_blockers: Bulb shape is completely wrong — flat trapezoid instead of rounded rubber hemisphere
Bottle silhouette is jar-like, not tall dropper bottle — fundamental proportion failure
Gold metallic collar absent — replaced by flat cream disk
Overall structure does not represent a dropper bottle; unrecognizable as the reference product

iteration_4.reference_description: A dropper bottle with a frosted blush-pink cylindrical glass body that has a gently rounded shoulder transitioning to a short neck. The closure assembly consists of a tall rose-gold/champagne metallic collar screwed onto the neck, topped by a dark plum/mauve rubber pipette bulb that is rounded-dome shaped at the top. The bottle carries 'BBROSE Rose Damascena Night Repair Oil' branding. The overall silhouette is a wide, squat cylinder with elegant proportions.
iteration_4.output_description: A flat/cartoon-style synthetic render showing a dropper bottle with a nearly rectangular body (very little shoulder curvature, nearly straight sides going almost to the top edge), a small stepped beige/cream collar segment, and a dark purple-grey truncated-rectangular/trapezoidal bulb shape at the top. The bulb reads as a flat pentagon or trapezoid rather than a rounded dome. The body is white-cream with no frosted translucency or branding. Proportions are taller and narrower than the reference, and the overall rendering style is 2D flat with no materials depth.
iteration_4.top_component_observed_shape: Flat trapezoidal/pentagonal dark shape — not a rounded dome bulb

component_semantics.evidence: The dark element at the top is positioned where a pipette bulb would be, but its shape is a flat trapezoid/pentagon rather than the expected rounded hemisphere of the reference's plum dome bulb.

visual_findings: Bulb shape is a flat pentagon/trapezoid, not the rounded dome seen in the reference.
Collar is a plain beige stepped block with no metallic rose-gold finish.
Body is rectangular with near-straight sides and minimal shoulder curvature; reference has a clearly rounded cylindrical shoulder.
No frosted blush-pink translucency; render is flat opaque white-cream.
Render is 2D flat-art style with no material depth, reflections, or surface finish.
No branding or label present on the body.
Overall proportions are taller and narrower than the squat cylindrical reference.
Previous iteration (Image 3) had a similar structural problem with bulb shape (flame/spike form); current iteration changes it to a flat trapezoid but still does not achieve the rounded dome.
critical_blockers: Bulb geometry is wrong — flat trapezoidal shape instead of rounded dome
Collar has no metallic rose-gold finish — critical brand identity element missing
Body silhouette is rectangular, not cylindrical with rounded shoulder
Frosted blush-pink glass material not represented
Flat 2D rendering lacks structural fidelity required for packaging structural render

supplier_requests.reason: the bounded same-domain discovery found no public specification (20 probes, all blocked); §14 directs a supplier request packet

requests.channel: public contact form or email — to be sent BY A HUMAN
requests.subject: 30 ml cylindrical serum bottle + dropper closure — technical specification request
requests.body:
Hello,

We are specifying packaging for a 30 ml cylindrical frosted-glass cosmetic serum bottle with a metallic dropper closure, and we need manufacturer specification data rather than marketing copy.

Could you send, for one exact product variant:

  - exact 30 ml bottle SKU
  - dimensional drawing
  - bottle diameter
  - bottle height without closure
  - neck finish
  - neck diameter
  - overflow capacity
  - glass weight
  - compatible dropper SKU
  - closure drawing
  - collar diameter
  - collar height
  - bulb/outer-cover construction
  - pipette length
  - total assembled height
  - materials
  - decoration methods
  - CAD/PDF files
  - MOQ and sample availability

A dimensional drawing or CAD file is the single most useful item. Please also confirm whether the visible dark component on your dropper closures is an exposed elastomer bulb, a bulb with an integral flared skirt, or a separate decorative outer cover, since that affects our design.

Thank you.
